message: 🚨 CRITICAL: Multiple services reporting DNS resolution failures for internal domains.
All internal .example.internal domains are failing DNS resolution. External domains seem fine. Was there an infra change?
We started migrating DNS from Route53 to Cloudflare at 3 AM. External zones were migrated but I forgot to migrate the internal zone (example.internal). Route53 was the authoritative resolver for it.
So once the NS records propagated and traffic shifted to Cloudflare, internal DNS broke because the zone doesn't exist there yet?
Exactly. Adding the internal zone to Cloudflare now. Should be quick since it's a private zone.
Internal zone is live on Cloudflare. All services should be resolving now.
Confirmed, all services healthy. ~35 minutes of internal DNS outage.
